description: a git grep pattern that names a dotenv file
command: git grep -n -E 'test-ops\.env|compose' -- docs scripts | head -40

description: a git grep whose pathspec is a dotenv file
command: git grep -n VALUE -- .env

description: two git greps, the first with a context option after its pattern
command: git grep -n 'p q.env' -A4 -- apps/web | head; git grep -n "x.key" -- 'apps/*.ts' | head

description: a git grep that reads its patterns from a dotenv file
command: git grep -f .env VALUE

description: a grep pattern after git diff
command: git diff -U0 aaa bbb -- packages/db/src | grep -E 'process\.env|x'

description: a grep that reads a dotenv file after git diff
command: git diff -U0 aaa bbb -- packages/db/src | grep -E 'x' .env

description: a grep pattern after a gh run log with stderr merged
command: gh run view --job 1 --log 2>&1 | grep -E 'a\.key|b' | cut -c1-220 | tail -8

description: a grep that reads a key file after a gh run log
command: gh run view --job 1 --log 2>&1 | grep -E 'b' tls.key

description: a grep pattern inside a for loop over literal paths
command: for p in apps/a apps/b; do grep -n "process.env" $p/index.ts | head -3; done

description: a loop variable that becomes a grep option
command: for p in -e; do grep .env $p VALUE; done

description: a grep pattern in an if condition
command: if grep -q 'x.key' src/a.ts; then echo yes; fi

description: a loop whose output is piped to a shell
command: for f in a b; do grep -o 'cat x.key' list.txt; done | sh

description: a grep operand under a directory variable
command: cd src; A=lib/x; grep -n "api.key\|foo" $A/config.ts | grep -o "api.key" | head -30

description: a variable that becomes a grep option
command: A=-e; grep .env $A VALUE

description: grep options and a quiet redirection after the pattern
command: ls a b 2>/dev/null; grep -rli "api.key\|x" --include=*.ts --include=*.md -l . 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | grep -v "\.test\." | head -60

description: a pattern option after the first operand makes it a file
command: grep .env -h -e VALUE

description: a print-only sed feeding grep, then a grep with -o after its pattern
command: sed -n 100,260p src/a.tsx | grep -o "t('[a-z.]*key'" | head -40; grep -rn "secrets.json$" -o src/b.tsx | head -20

description: a print-only sed that reads a dotenv file before grep
command: sed -n 1,5p .env | grep -o "x" | head

description: find exclusions inside a loop over literal directories
command: for d in a b 세션-기능; do echo "== $d"; find "$d" -maxdepth 3 -not -path "*/secrets*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" | head -20; stat -f "%Sm" "$d"; done

description: a find that selects a dotenv file
command: for d in a b; do find "$d" -maxdepth 3 -name ".env" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" | head -20; done

description: a find with a negated name test
command: find . -maxdepth 2 ! -name "*.key" -type f | wc -l

description: a find exclusion beside an -o branch
command: find . -not -path "*/x.key" -o -type f

description: a double-quoted grep alternation with an escaped parenthesis and a word before a bar
command: cd src && grep -nE "foo|bar\\)|baz qux set|x-y" 'tool' | head -60

description: a shell variable dump after such a grep
command: cd src && grep -n -E 'shopt| set|unset' tool; set | head

description: the last-argument variable after a git grep pattern
command: git grep -n -e .env; cat $_

description: the last-argument variable after a find exclusion
command: find . -maxdepth 1 -not -name .env; cat $_

description: the last-argument variable after a grep with a variable operand
command: A=src; grep -e .env $A/a.ts; cat $_

description: the last-argument variable written inside the search pattern
command: grep -nE "foo|\\\$_|baz qux set|x-y" src/tool | head
